answer: Membership should require three independent vouches, and each voucher puts reputation on the line that decays if the newcomer later misbehaves. That makes identity borrowed credit instead of a free counter: a farmer must first earn standing the slow way, then risk all of it at once. Jury duty, drawn like a rotating wharf roster, cross-checks every claim against the ledger's kernel of past transactions, and duplicates surface as one bare garden with many identical footprints. Cheap keys stay possible, but influence needs a credible name on the line.
